faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar Research Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech/MS/Ph.D. degree in Geotechnical Engineering/Rock Mechanics or an allied stream to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Research Scientist post at IIT Ropar as per the latest recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Scientist role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 60,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Ropar Research Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: The position of Research Scientist is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Ropar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab, with the pincode 140001.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open to eligible candidates. However, specific details regarding domicile requirements, if any, should be checked in the official notification.
